== Windows says "Windows protected your PC" ==
The installer isn't code-signed yet. Click '''More info → Run anyway'''.

== macOS won't open the app ==
Right-click (or Control-click) Rexy 360 → '''Open → Open'''. If it still refuses, go to System Settings → Privacy & Security and click '''Open Anyway'''.

== My controller does nothing on a Mac ==
Allow '''Input Monitoring''' for Rexy 360 (System Settings → Privacy & Security → Input Monitoring), then restart Rexy 360.

== My Rexy Wheels aren't detected ==
Make sure the wheels are in '''joystick mode''', then '''Bind''' each axis again in Head — Pan · Tilt · Roll.

== My hand wheels only act as a mouse ==
On Windows, use '''Alt Inputs → Mouse devices''': tick '''listen''', then Bind. Press '''Ctrl+M''' so the wheels don't move the pointer. See [[Rexy 360: Controllers and inputs#Mouse devices (Windows)|Mouse devices]].

== "Not a 360 file" ==
Rexy 360 needs stitched (equirectangular) footage. Export an equirectangular video from Insta360 Studio or GoPro Player. YouTube cubemaps squeezed into 16:9 are converted automatically since 1.0.2-beta.

== HEVC render fails ==
HEVC renders need a graphics-card encoder that does HEVC. Choose H.264 or ProRes instead.

== Scrubbing is jerky ==
Wait for the proxy to finish building (progress at the bottom of the viewer).

== Still stuck? ==
Email '''rob@realprogear.com''' with your Rexy 360 version and what happened.
